finding: Capacity-dependent probe rankings do not map monotonically to policy utility
quantitative_evidence: At 70%, scaled-minus-small mean deficits are negative in all eight environment/size contrasts, robust to every leave-one-seed-out analysis. Dog medium-minus-small final return −74.36 [−126.83, −19.10], while final deficit difference −.22875 [−.26892, −.19012], eight paired seeds
counterexamples: Humanoid policy differences uncertain; large terminal n=6. Not every individual seed follows every policy ranking
mechanisms: Reference difficulty, useful representation differences, visitation and optimization
significance_and_test: Strongest defensible protocol-specific contribution. Test a critic intervention that changes the isolated phenotype and matched policy outcomes

finding: Fresh-reference deterioration replicates throughout the grid
quantitative_evidence: Initial-to-70% fresh score falls in 96/96 conditions; eight seeds in each of 12 cells. Mean declines .00629→.03251 across dog sizes, .03217→.15345 humanoid, .06193→.14315 key, .08957→.24645 pen
counterexamples: Teachers/pools/normalizers change; fixed initialization is reused. This is not proof of replay-only causation
mechanisms: Changing task/reference difficulty and architecture-dependent optimizer sensitivity
significance_and_test: A longitudinal probe needs reference decomposition. Hold replay, teacher, normalization and minibatch sequence fixed across checkpoints

finding: A negative deficit can be driven primarily by a worsening reference
quantitative_evidence: Large humanoid: check1→35 fresh score −.14726, current −.00350, arithmetic mean deficit −.14375; eight training seeds. Arithmetic paired decomposition is exact
counterexamples: Pen small trained score −8.53232 versus fresh −.08151, so reference drift cannot explain all large deficits
mechanisms: Reference difficulty versus genuine trained adaptation change
significance_and_test: Demonstrates why one deficit trajectory is mechanistically ambiguous. Crossed replay/teacher/learner controls distinguish components

finding: Myo Q signals predict return changes more reliably than deficit alone
quantitative_evidence: Excluding pilot seed1: Q-only held-out MSE reductions 5.83% key and 23.61% pen; combined 5.29%/23.30%. Seven held-out seed groups, three architectures per environment
counterexamples: Deficit-only gains uncertain; humanoid added predictors worsen results; no independent prospective test
mechanisms: Reward/visitation state, value scale, value error or actor exploitation
significance_and_test: Does not establish plasticity propagation. Retain fixed model and assess newly independent seeds or calibrated value errors

finding: Large Myo deficits can coexist with useful actors; low errors can coexist with nonlearning
quantitative_evidence: Pen small final return 1571.02 (n=8), final deficit 8.39523; medium 750.79 and 1.29615 (n=8). Near 60–70% median reward/Q: small 60.48/2097.60 versus medium 1.01/26.40
counterexamples: Small pen seed4 temporarily has large deficit and low return; wide seed variability. High deficit is not beneficial by itself
mechanisms: Easy low-reward replay versus harder high-value functions; representation and optimization
significance_and_test: Avoid treating low TD/probe error as an architecture success criterion. Compare identical replay/task supports

finding: Most operational policy drops are transient or persistence-uncertain
quantitative_evidence: 20/17/12 runs meet 20/30/50% definitions after progress/skill gates; only 3/2/0 have two consecutive qualifying evaluations. All 96 campaign runs remain in denominator
counterexamples: Five-episode intermediate evaluations; final 50 episodes; low-peak run makes percentages misleading; crash censoring
mechanisms: Evaluation variability, policy/replay feedback, temporary critic exploitation
significance_and_test: Study skill acquisition, recoverable instability and sustained degradation separately. Recover episode distributions first

finding: Crashed records share a common wall-clock stopping pattern
quantitative_evidence: Eight D4W1536 records, seeds7–8, all same host; last histories within351.68s despite two start-time groups and differing progress
counterexamples: No output logs or scheduler cause; cannot certify timeout or exclude numerical problems
mechanisms: Common allocation/node event versus independent numerical failure
confidence_and_type: High timing observation; moderate external-event hypothesis
significance_and_test: Prevent crash labels from becoming scientific instability labels. Retrieve read-only scheduler/node logs

finding: Pilot and campaign seed1 are observationally identical in training metrics
quantitative_evidence: Seven counterpart pairs, 7,989 exact shared training/evaluation values each; 55,923/55,923 matches
counterexamples: Source/probe protocol and launch dates differ; exact values alone do not prove checkpoint reuse
mechanisms: Deterministic same-seed rerun or shared underlying trajectory evidence
significance_and_test: Those records are not independent replication. Main conclusions tested again without seed1

finding: Original archived pen-small probe has a large trained fitting gap despite major progress
quantitative_evidence: Seed5 check50, ten paired rounds: median current initial minibatch MSE164001.53 and final pool14.8014; fresh .87561 and .14227; exact W&B score binding
counterexamples: One training seed and one architecture; initial minibatch and final pool losses differ; no universal spike test
mechanisms: Initial centered output variation, conditioning, finite budget, representation change
significance_and_test: Recover full independent curves before claiming architecture-dependent transients

finding: Important source/logging distinctions change analysis validity
quantitative_evidence: Ten-round fractional IQM reproduces all4,738 nonzero-check deficits exactly. Fresh IQM logged only initially; later values reconstructed from rounds. Terminal evaluations use50 episodes versus5 earlier
counterexamples: Reconstructed scores remain conditional measurements; no episode-level uncertainty
significance_and_test: Metric names alone are insufficient. Freeze source equations and counters alongside data
